profiles.description: One entry per M365 identity. The key is the model-ID prefix (ato/gpt-6.1-sol).

port.description: Port this profile's proxy listens on.

dataDir.description: Credentials, MSAL cache, browser profile and logs. Relative to the repo root; ~ is expanded.

env.description: Extra environment for the profile's proxy, e.g. M365_AGENT_ID or M365_FRAMING_VARIANT. Values win over .env.

models.description: Optional allow-list used by `pnpm profiles sync`; absent means every advertised model.
